title: Will Choosin' Texas be #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 during the week of Nov 7, 2026
rules: If Choosin' Texas is #1 on the Billboard Hot 100  chart for the Week of Nov 7, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: This market and these products have not been endorsed by Billboard. Any references to "Billboard", the "Hot 100," or any other associated marks are descriptive only, and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Billboard and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Choosin' Texas just took back #1 on the Oct 31 chart for a record 25th week. It has a huge radio lead (58.6M vs 12.7M impressions over its closest rival, Tate McRae's 'Housewife') and has repeatedly returned to the top this year. 'Housewife' beat it on streams in its debut week, but second-week streams usually fall, and no big release in the Oct 23-29 tracking week looks able to debut at #1. The main risk is that 'Housewife' holds its streams, grows its radio play or gets a sales push and edges ahead in a close race.
blind.falsifier: Billboard's Nov 7, 2026 Hot 100 (published around Nov 2) shows 'Housewife' or another song at #1, for example because new versions or variants boosted its sales or its second-week streams held unusually well.

final.reasoning: The market midpoint (0.755) is close to my estimate, and the wide spread means buying YES at the 0.82 ask would cost more than my 0.79 fair value. The leftover edge over the midpoint is too small to justify a trade.
